sentences.en: Maternity nurses, midwives and doctors oversee the birth.
sentences.zh: 助产士、接生员和医生负责监督分娩过程。

sentences.en: Tom is in charge of overseeing the entire project.
sentences.zh: 汤姆负责全程监督整个项目。

sentences.en: The manager oversees all departments to ensure smooth operations.
sentences.zh: 经理监督所有部门以确保运作顺畅。

senses.zh: 监督；审查；俯瞰；偷看到，无意中看到
